page.notes: Uncertain readings: "necessariŏ" (the mark over the o is unclear); the last word of the second paragraph is cut off at the bottom edge. The left-margin notes are cut at the right edge, so "finitioni" is uncertain. Their placement is beside the continuing text, so they are attached to the end of the visible paragraph. The two left-margin fragments "de" and "is." are split across two lines and are read as parts of one marginal note; the note's full text is not visible on this part. The stray dash-like mark at the left edge, beside the first paragraph group, is not printed text and was left out. The right-hand strip is the neighbouring page and was excluded. Long s is written as s throughout.
